title: MEGA-BENCH: SCALING MULTIMODAL EVALUATION TO OVER 500 REAL-WORLD TASKS
reasoning: The benchmark includes a dedicated skill dimension for 'Ethical & Safety Reasoning' consisting of 15 tasks and 245 samples. These tasks specifically include 'Red Teaming Racial' and 'Red Teaming Politics' evaluations, as well as the 'Llavaguard' safety benchmark, which are used to measure the moral and ethical alignment of models.
